description: This file defines the NotificationGroup class, which models the <notification-group> element in an XML-based configuration. It handles parsing of XML elements related to notification groups, including nested notification and notify elements, and provides accessors for their properties.

classes.name: NotificationGroup
classes.description: Models a group of notifications as defined in XML configuration, ensuring thread safety and encapsulating notification details.

methods.name: NotificationGroup
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a NotificationGroup instance by parsing the provided XML element, extracting 'name', 'notification', and 'notify' elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the notification group.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Returns the Notification object associated with this group.

methods.name: getNotifyList
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of Notify objects in the group.
